distribution: real molecular graphs and labels without plaintext SMILES
source_filtering: Within each original CSV split, retain first row for each exact SMILES, matching the supplied legacy training dataset. Graph cache selection uses the last valid cached occurrence.
graph_source: Existing provided graph cache; no conformers regenerated
graph_order: all 2D graphs then all 3D graphs within each shard
structural_recoverability: Molecular graph inputs retain structure information and remain paired with real labels. No anonymity or confidentiality guarantee is made.
validation: Every exported graph topology and model-input tensor round-tripped identically; numeric label, mask, ID arrays round-tripped identically.
